title: monitor: Keep power save state consistent when output power setup fails
description:
`zwlr_output_power_v1` allows one power object per output, so phosh's request is
refused with `failed` when another client already holds it for the panel.

`wlr_output_power_handle_failed()` only logged a warning, which left
`PhoshMonitor.power_mode` at `PHOSH_MONITOR_POWER_SAVE_MODE_OFF`. The screen
saver manager derives `active` from that value, so the shell considered the
panel blanked forever: `GetActive()` stayed `TRUE`, the power key did nothing,
and idle blanking never happened.

Set the mode to on in the failed handler and drop the inert object. The next
`phosh_monitor_set_power_save_mode()` asks for a fresh object, so power control
comes back once the other client is gone; if the request is refused again the
failed handler keeps the local state in sync.

Tested on Lenovo Y700 (SM8750P, aarch64), Debian sid, phoc 0.59rc1 with in-tree
wlroots + phosh 0.58/0.59rc1.

title: Add tray quicksetting to handle SNI
description:
## Summary

A new quick setting plugin that implements a StatusNotifierItem (SNI) host for phosh. It allows tray applications (nm-applet, Chrome, Electron apps like QQ) to register their tray icons and provides an inline DBus menu browser with multi-level submenu navigation — all within the phosh quick settings panel, with no popup windows (Wayland-safe).

## Features

- **SNI Watcher + Host** — implements `org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher` and `org.kde.StatusNotifierHost-<pid>`
- **DBus Menu support** — renders `com.canonical.dbusmenu` menus inline with multi-level submenu navigation
- **Icon support** — handles both `IconName` (freedesktop theme icons) and `IconPixmap` (raw ARGB pixel data)
- **Activate fallback chain** — tries Activate, SecondaryActivate, ContextMenu since not all apps implement all methods
- **Live updates** — items appear/disappear as apps start/stop in real time via `NameOwnerChanged`
- **Wayland-native** — no X11 popups, all content rendered in the phosh status page

## Implementation Details

- The SNI watcher runs in-process within the plugin (no separate daemon)
- Uses atomic refcounting on `SniItem` to handle the async proxy creation race (item can be removed while `g_dbus_proxy_new` is in flight)
- Icon pixmaps are decoded with `memcpy` to avoid unaligned access (UB on aarch64)
- Status icon is bundled in the GResource and registered via `gtk_icon_theme_add_resource_path`

## Testing

Tested with nm-applet, Linux QQ (flatpak) on wsl arch （distrobox debian）

title: app-grid: Removing the overshoot for improving performance
description:
Scrolling on the app grid when the bottom of the list is visible produces an overshoot. On devices where phosh is rasterized on the CPU, this is very expensive. Since the app list isn't very large, most of the time, this overshoot is computed as the bottom is never far. Removing this overshoot on samsung,jflte changes the app list framerate from \~20fps to \~45fps.

The overshoot itself is also very hard to see under normal use. Undershoot removal was also tested but changed nothing to performance.

Tested on Samsung Galaxy S4 I9505, codename jflte.

Signed-off-by: Alexandre MINETTE contact@alex-min.fr

Maybe hard to see on video but if you focus your eyes on the scrollbar or the "Show All apps" button, you can see the jittering:

| Build | Scenario | Mean fps | Median fps | p95 frame | Frames over 25 ms | phosh CPU | phoc CPU |
|-------|----------|----------|------------|-----------|-------------------|-----------|----------|
| stock 0.58.0 | In range | 29.7 | 29.9 | 50.1 ms | 89% | 15.3 s | 11.2 s |
| stock 0.58.0 | Edge (overshoot) | 24.9 | 29.9 | 83.5 ms | 75% | 21.2 s | 4.8 s |
| with overshoot rule | In range | 29.5 | 29.9 | 50.1 ms | 92% | 15.3 s | 11.3 s |
| with overshoot rule | Edge (overshoot) | 50.1 | 59.9 | 33.4 ms | 12% | 10.0 s | 8.3 s |

_Frames are counted from DRM page flips (`drm:drm_vblank_event_delivered`) with `measure-scroll-fps.py`._

[measure-scroll-fps.py](/uploads/33021f1723c5b3393ae293db20659792/measure-scroll-fps.py)

### Before the fix:

![before_small.mp4](/uploads/e0a449610eda9455f1a319c98d44159a/before_small.mp4){width="338" height="600"}

### After the fix

![after_small.mp4](/uploads/7290db9f8c9f2137c650f0c225903dfa/after_small.mp4){width="338" height="600"}

title: Draft: Allow to screenshot applications to detect e.g. adaptiveness issues
description:
Often one wants to know if certain pages of an app fit on mobile. With

```sh
meson setup -Dtests=true -Dtools=true _build
meson compile -C _build
_build/tools/check-adaptive tools/examples/phosh-mobile-settings.acheck
```

you can switch through the different pages and have them screenshoted by describing the navigation patterns like:

```ini
[app]
name = phosh-mobile-settings
exec = phosh-mobile-settings
quit = <ctrl>Q

[main]
shortcuts=

[welcome-tab]
shortcuts=Tab;Return;

[feedback-tab]
shortcuts=Return;Tab;Return;

[compositor-tab]
shortcuts=Return;Tab;Return;

[lockscreen-tab]
shortcuts=Return;Tab;Return;

[convergence-tab]
shortcuts=Return;Tab;Return;
```

Which gives you

![Phosh Mobile Settings screenshots](/uploads/73646e891f0d95663f1127e8b83333b8/a.png)

This is marked as draft as I won't be able to look into cleaning this up for merging near tearm but the functionality might already be useful when you don't want to check your app manually every time.

title: Split Overview page from app grid
description:
This change introduces following improvements:
- Separate page for running activities to give them more space and visibility.
- Button on left side of home bar to activate overview page.
- OSK button is always visible, it may be needed for control OSK for app search when home unfolded.
- Activities use maximum 70% of screen width to allow get visible neighbor activities.
- Centered preview and rounded corners of activity (maybe also need to limit drag area only to thumbnail area).
- Activated activity moves to end of carousel and carousel scrolled to to previous one. Allows access most recent open apps first.
- Disable fold when new activity added (when user launched app and then unfold home again before activity launched)
- Disable scroll on activity activation when overview unfolded to not disrupt user's scrolling progress.

It is alternative change like !1079 but more android-like with separate button to open activities list
Grabbed multitasking image from there.

Known issues:
- HdyCarousel doesn't support different-size pages, so each activity takes widest size.
- When OSK enabled, some windows flaps win size, so update thumbnail disabled for this.
- After rotation sometimes for some windows thumbnail has wrong size, it seems because request_thumbnail runs before window finished.

title: Split the app grid out from the overview
description:
This:
- replaces the scrollable app grid from the overview by a paginated app carousel
- puts the app carousel in a page below the overview
- moves the favorites at the beginning of the app carousel
- moves the search bar above the running apps so we can display the results without having UI elements jumping around

It's still a prototype and I'm polishing it, but if you want you can already pick the package from the CI and try it on PureOS Byzantium with https://source.puri.sm/Librem5/developer.puri.sm/-/issues/193.

Please note there are some known and likely unknown regressions, so test it at your own risk while I polish it.

What it looks like at the creation of the MR:
